'''Tana Jadance''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. She had at one point visited the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Voss]], [[Voss-Ka]].
